title: Consumer Appetite for Personal AI Goes Mainstream
caption:
New data shows 70% of people are looking for an AI assistant that can manage their daily life. But there is one major hurdle companies have to clear first: trust.

Source: Spectrum - Consumer Appetite for Personal AI Goes Mainstream
